channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: The Queen Elizabeth Hospital receives national award for its veterans support
item.description: A hospital trust has renewed its highest-level award for supporting the armed forces community.

item.title: BBC Gladiators star Zack George visits primary school and does a handstand
item.description: Athlete and television personality Zack George visited Bungay Primary School to show off his impressive skills and impart some valuable life lessons.

item.title: Corner street pub up to go under the hammer
item.description: A historic street-corner pub in a Suffolk town is being offered for sale.

item.title: Woman sheds four stone after getting 'kick up the rear' with health scare
item.description: A woman from Gressenhall has shared her Slimming World success story after losing a remarkable four stone.

item.title: Plans to scrap A-levels at Norfolk sixth form 'leaked' by other school
item.description: Head of school shares disappointment after plans to scrap A-levels at Sheringham Sixth Form were said to be 'leaked' early by Cromer Academy.

item.title: Road to shut for nearly a month during £135,000 works
item.description: Old Palace Road off Heigham Street in Norwich will be closed for nearly a month for the replacement of traffic signals.

item.title: Crab company demands compensation from wind farm operators for decline in catch
item.description: Jonas Seafood, Cromer's largest producer of dressed crab, wants compensation from wind farm operators for a downturn in supply.

item.title: Drone photo reveals latest progress on A47 dualling works... but when will it open?
item.description: Traffic could move to the new dualled section of the A47 between Blofield and North Burlingham as soon as this spring.

item.title: Four adults and three children taken to hospital after crash on major road
item.description: Four adults and three children were taken to the Norfolk and Norwich University Hospital after a crash on the A140 at Long Stratton.

item.title: WATCH: Moment murder suspect is arrested in Norwich
item.description: A video has shown the moment a man was arrested on suspicion of murdering a woman in Thorpe St Andrew, near Norwich.
